profile.name: TCP数据采样进程
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件采样组件，用于在实验数据采集链路中通过 TCP 接收数据包、提取有用报文内容、缓存原始数据，并可选择将数据写入磁盘。它更像是面向测试或数据传输基准比较的进程式采样工具，而不是直接控制某台实体仪器。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software sampling component used in laboratory data-acquisition pipelines to receive packets over TCP, extract useful packet content, buffer raw data, and optionally record data to disk. It appears to be a process-based sampler intended for testing or TCP/UDP transfer benchmarking rather than direct control of a physical instrument.
